'''Daimanate Dynamic Testing Facility (Darkknell)''', also known as the '''Black Fang''', was the main research facility of the [[Daimanate]], located in [[Xakrea]]. There, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] developed new war technology to combat his older brother [[Odion]] in their never-ending attempts to one-up one another in rival combat. This technology included the [[Convergence (starship)|''Convergence'']], which looked like a dark, lopsided pyramid and had few entrances which were all guarded.
